updateProcedure: Retrieve upstream artifact from sourceUrl/sourceRef and verify authenticity out-of-band.
Compute SHA-256 for the candidate file and update expectedSha256.
Run pnpm runtime-artifacts:hash:update, pnpm binary-provenance:check, and pnpm runtime-artifacts:hash:verify.
Document provenance update rationale in notes/worklog.md.
